programs.name: 5/3/1 for Beginners
programs.description: Wendler's classic strength template. Three days a week, one main lift per day working up to a heavy top set, plus light accessory work.

programs.name: Full Body Beginner
programs.description: A simple StrongLifts-style full body split for your first months of lifting. Squat every session, alternate upper body pushing and pulling.

programs.name: Upper/Lower 4-Day
programs.description: A four day upper/lower split balancing pressing, pulling and lower body volume for steady strength gains.

programs.name: Push Pull Legs
programs.description: A six day push/pull/legs split run twice a week, built for hypertrophy with higher exercise volume per muscle group.

programs.name: GZCLP
programs.description: Cody LeFever's linear progression program. Four days a week pairing a heavy Tier 1 lift with moderate Tier 2 and light Tier 3 accessory work.

programs.name: Bear Mode 12-Week Conjugate
programs.description: 12-week conjugate Upper / Lower / Full Body / Arm Day for late-intermediate lifters. Two working sets per exercise, grips and press variations rotating every 3 weeks, with a yoke, neck and heavy-ab focus for a thick Bear Mode physique.

programs.name: Powerbuilding A/B/A Conjugate
programs.description: 3-day full-body powerbuilding on an A/B/A - B/A/B rotation. A rotating max-effort single plus 70% back-downs, then two-set antagonist supersets, weak-point isolation and daily shoulder prehab. No dynamic effort, reactive deload.

programs.name: Hybrid 2x Full Body + 2x GPP Fat Loss
programs.description: Strength retention in a calorie deficit: two low-volume two-set full-body sessions (Mon/Thu) with antagonist supersets and no axial barbell lifts, plus two GPP days (Tue/Fri) for conditioning, neck, calves, abs and joint prehab. Switches to low-impact conditioning in the second half.
